Cross the suppression lists with the channel's recipients

suppression_match.Rd

Addresses compare without case and without blanks at the edges. The four lists that suppress are a state, any entry whatever its age; Blocks is an event. So is soppressi_recapiti_nuovi, the recipients with an entry that is new: created in the 24 hours before the last cut, cut UTC, the time the job's timer starts, at or before now. The window is aligned to the timer and not to the moment of the run, which comes up to five minutes later (RandomizedDelaySec=300): an entry made between the cut and the run counts the next day, and every entry counts on one day only, with no overlap and no gap between two runs of the timer. A run by hand on the same day counts the same window. A day with no run at all (the machine off from before one cut to after the next) loses its entries as news; one of the four lists stays in the state counts and in the mail to IT.

Usage

suppression_match(reading, recipients, now, cut = "06:30")

Arguments

reading

What suppression_read() answered, or NULL when nothing was read.

recipients

What suppression_recipients() answered.

now

The moment the run reads.

cut

The time of day, "%H:%M" in UTC, at which the job's timer starts (OnCalendar=*-*-* 06:30:00 UTC). If the timer moves, this moves with it.

Value

A list with soppressioni_lette, soppressa_casella_it, soppressi_referenti, soppressi_recapiti, soppressi_recapiti_nuovi, bloccati_nuovi, and dettaglio, a data frame of lista, classe, record_id (the rows of the address, separated by commas), creata (UTC, to the minute), motivo (the service's reason, on one line and cut) and indirizzo: one row per address, class and entry that counts.

Details

Counts and nothing else for the record, which a workspace keeps and others read: never an address, and no hash of one, which on a known domain is reversed by dictionary. The addresses are in dettaglio, which the runner writes to the standard error, the unit's journal.

NA is "not computed", not zero. With the lists not read every count is NA. With the lists read, the address of IT is judged whenever there is one, and the rest only with the register and the directory read; bloccati_nuovi counts the three classes, so it needs all of them read that can be. soppressioni_lette is the lists read whole and the register and the directory read.
